segments.an3.92:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, kassako gahapati sīghaṃ sīghaṃ khettaṃ sukaṭṭhaṃ karoti sumatikataṃ.
segments.an3.92:1.4: Sīghaṃ sīghaṃ khettaṃ sukaṭṭhaṃ karitvā sumatikataṃ sīghaṃ sīghaṃ bījāni patiṭṭhāpeti.
segments.an3.92:1.5: Sīghaṃ sīghaṃ bījāni patiṭṭhāpetvā sīghaṃ sīghaṃ udakaṃ abhinetipi apanetipi.
segments.an3.92:1.6: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi kassakassa gahapatissa accāyikāni karaṇīyāni.
segments.an3.92:1.7: Tassa kho taṃ, bhikkhave, kassakassa gahapatissa natthi sā iddhi vā ānubhāvo vā –
segments.an3.92:1.8: ‘ajjeva me dhaññāni jāyantu, sveva gabbhīni hontu, uttarasveva paccantū’ti.
segments.an3.92:1.9: Atha kho, bhikkhave, hoti so samayo yaṃ tassa kassakassa gahapatissa tāni dhaññāni utupariṇāmīni jāyantipi gabbhīnipi honti paccantipi.
segments.an3.92:2.1: “Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tīṇimāni bhikkhussa accāyikāni karaṇīyāni.
segments.an3.92:2.3: Adhisīlasikkhāsamādānaṃ, adhicittasikkhāsamādānaṃ, adhipaññāsikkhāsamādānaṃ – imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi bhikkhussa accāyikāni karaṇīyāni.
segments.an3.92:2.5: Tassa kho taṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno natthi sā iddhi vā anubhāvo vā –
segments.an3.92:2.6: ‘ajjeva me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccatu sve vā uttarasve vā’ti.
segments.an3.92:2.7: Atha kho, bhikkhave, hoti so samayo yaṃ tassa bhikkhuno adhisīlampi sikkhato adhicittampi sikkhato adhipaññampi sikkhato anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
segments.an3.92:3.2: ‘tibbo no chando bhavissati adhisīlasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo chando bhavissati adhicittasikkhāsamādāne, tibbo chando bhavissati adhipaññāsikkhāsamādāne’ti.

lines: Yañhi na avassaṃ kātabbaṃ, taṃ kiccanti vuccati.
Natthi sā iddhi vā ānubhāvo vāti sā vā iddhi so vā ānubhāvo natthi.
Jāyantipīti tatiyadivase nikkhantasetaṅkurāni honti, sattāhe patte nīlaṅkurāni honti.
Idāni yasmā buddhānaṃ gahapatikena vā sassehi vā attho natthi, sāsane pana tappaṭirūpakaṃ puggalaṃ vā atthaṃ vā dassetuṃ taṃ taṃ opammaṃ āharanti.
Tasmā yamatthaṃ dassetukāmena etaṃ ābhataṃ, taṃ dassento evameva khotiādimāha.
Sikkhā pana idhāpi missikā eva kathitā.
